tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground for every page, card and fragment.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Quiet bands and the frame around a mock or an in-use page.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Illustration plates and the closing band.

tokens.name: tray
tokens.usage: Neutral chip ground and progress track inside fragments.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders and the nav rule; runs the full length of its container.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Rules that must show on `plate`.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Dashed border of placeholders (portraits, customer stories).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body on `surface`, `ground` and `plate` (19:1 on white). Never pure black.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and paragraph text beside headings (9.9:1 on `plate`).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, meta, place names and roles on `surface` (5.1:1) and `plate` (4.7:1).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Icons and marks that carry no meaning; never text.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons, eyebrows, checks, the focus ring (5.2:1 on white).

tokens.name: blue-strong
tokens.usage: Hover on primary buttons; blue text on `blue-soft`.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of blue chips inside fragments; text on it is `blue-strong`.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `blue` (5.2:1).

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: The logo mark, always, and the letterhead rules. Nothing else.

tokens.name: device
tokens.usage: Device tiles (Kora, CounterMini) and device bodies.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done or valid, as text on `ok-soft` (5.2:1), always with a word.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of ok chips.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Due soon, as text on `warn-soft` (5.3:1), always with a word.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warn chips.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Expired or failed, as text on `bad-soft` (5.8:1), always with a word.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of bad chips.

tokens.name: iso-top
tokens.usage: Top faces in the isometric street.

tokens.name: iso-lit
tokens.usage: Lit side faces in the isometric street.

tokens.name: iso-shade
tokens.usage: Shaded side faces in the isometric street.

tokens.name: tender
tokens.usage: Tender (sales, pos and payments): its mark tile and its fragment's chips and bars only; never page accents or small text.
